options.A: August 18, 1945

questions.answer_text: The incident occurred on August 18, 1945.

options.A: Tokyo

questions.answer_text: Netaji was flying en route to Tokyo via Taiwan.

questions.question: What happened to the airplane engine during takeoff?

options.A: Never! Their courage and love for India live forever in our hearts

questions.answer_text: 'Jai Hind!' is our glorious national salutation gifted by Netaji.

questions.question: What event took place at Taipei Airport on August 18, 1945?
questions.reference_answer: On August 18, 1945, the military bomber carrying Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose and Colonel Habibur Rahman suffered engine trouble upon takeoff in Taipei, Taiwan, and crashed, severely injuring Netaji.

questions.question: How does India honor Netaji's memory and sacrifice today?
questions.reference_answer: India honors Netaji as a supreme national hero. His birthday on January 23 is celebrated nationwide as Parakram Diwas (Day of Valour), and his slogan 'Jai Hind' is the national salutation of India.

What model of aircraft was carrying Netaji when it crashed at Matsuyama Airport in Taipei?

options.A: Mitsubishi Ki-21 (Sally) twin-engine heavy bomber

questions.answer_text: The aircraft was an Imperial Japanese Army Mitsubishi Ki-21 heavy bomber.

questions.question: What final words did Netaji speak to Colonel Habibur Rahman in the hospital before passing away?

options.A: 'Habib, my end is near. I have fought for my country's freedom till the last. Go and tell my countrymen that they should continue the struggle for freedom.'

questions.answer_text: Netaji's dying words to Habibur Rahman were a sacred charge to the Indian people to never stop fighting for complete freedom.

questions.question: In which temple in Tokyo, Japan, are Netaji's reported sacred ashes (relics) preserved with deep reverence?

options.A: Renkoji Temple (Renko-ji)

questions.answer_text: The sacred relics are preserved at Renkoji Temple in Suginami ward, Tokyo.

questions.question: Who was the chief Japanese medical doctor who treated Netaji at Nanmon Military Hospital?

options.A: Dr. Toyoshi Tsuruta and Dr. Yoshimi

questions.answer_text: Dr. Toyoshi Tsuruta and Dr. Taneyoshi Yoshimi attended to Netaji with profound respect.

questions.question: What official inquiry commissions were formed by the Indian Government to investigate Netaji's death/disappearance?

options.A: Shah Nawaz Committee (1956), Khosla Commission (1970), and Justice Mukherjee Commission (1999)

questions.answer_text: Three high-level commissions investigated the circumstances of Netaji's reported death in Taipei.

questions.question: Why has the mystery of Netaji's disappearance captured the imagination of generations of Indians?

options.A: Because of conflicting testimonies, secret intelligence reports, and beliefs that Netaji might have survived into the post-war era as an ascetic
options.B: Because nobody knew who Netaji was
options.C: Because no photographs existed of him
options.D: Because it was an ancient mythological story

questions.answer_text: The lack of conclusive public photographs and declassified files created an enduring global mystery.

questions.question: What grand holographic and granite statue was recently installed in New Delhi to honor Netaji?

options.A: A grand statue under the Grand Canopy at India Gate
options.C: A statue at the railway platform
options.D: A statue inside a shopping mall

questions.answer_text: A monumental 28-foot granite statue of Netaji was installed beneath the historic canopy at India Gate.

questions.question: What profound impact did Netaji's life have on international anti-colonial movements across Asia and Africa?

options.A: It proved that colonized nations could establish their own armies and defeat Western imperialist powers by force of arms
options.B: It discouraged all other nations from seeking independence
options.C: It caused people to avoid political organizing

questions.answer_text: Netaji's fearless armed struggle inspired anti-imperialist freedom movements across the globe.

questions.question: Describe what occurred at Nanmon Military Hospital in Taipei following the air crash on August 18, 1945.
questions.reference_answer: Netaji was brought to Nanmon Military Hospital suffering from severe third-degree burns. Attended by Japanese doctors and Col. Habibur Rahman, he remained conscious and calm, declaring his love for India before passing away late that evening.

questions.question: Explain the significance of the Renkoji Temple in Tokyo in relation to Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose.
questions.reference_answer: Renkoji Temple is a Buddhist temple in Tokyo, Japan, where the purported cremated ashes and sacred relics of Netaji have been safeguarded with continuous prayers and immense reverence since September 1945.

questions.question: Summarize the overarching historical legacy of Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose in India's independence movement.
questions.reference_answer: Netaji was the supreme revolutionary leader whose creation of the INA, secular unity, fearless diplomacy, and armed campaign shattered British imperial authority, directly delivering the final blow that won India's freedom in 1947.

What technical mechanical failure caused the crash of the Mitsubishi Ki-21 bomber carrying Netaji immediately following takeoff from Taipei?

options.A: A catastrophic propeller blade separation and engine port malfunction caused severe asymmetric thrust, causing the bomber to stall and crash into the airfield periphery
options.B: The pilot turned off the engine accidentally
options.C: It collided with another airplane mid-air
options.D: It ran out of fuel during high altitude cruise

questions.answer_text: Aviation reports cited port engine propeller failure causing catastrophic loss of climb velocity.

questions.question: What was the official conclusion of the Justice Mukherjee Commission of Inquiry (1999-2005) regarding the Taipei crash?

options.A: It concluded that the air crash did not occur as alleged and that Netaji did not die in Taipei on August 18, 1945, though this finding was not accepted by the government
options.B: It confirmed the crash with 100% photographic evidence
options.C: It stated that Netaji lived in London after 1945
options.D: It refused to submit any report

questions.answer_text: The Mukherjee Commission concluded the air crash was a staged diversion, though earlier commissions (Shah Nawaz and Khosla) affirmed the crash.

questions.question: What notable Japanese military officer and pilot perished in the same Taipei aircraft crash alongside Netaji?

options.A: Lieutenant General Tsunamasa Shidei (Vice Chief of Staff of the Burma Area Army)

questions.answer_text: Lt. Gen. Tsunamasa Shidei, a key liaison officer for Soviet negotiations, was killed instantly in the crash.

questions.question: What was the final disposition of the gold and jewels carried in Netaji's baggage from Saigon?

options.A: Part of the melted treasure was recovered from the crash site and handed over by Col. Habibur Rahman to the Indian Mission in Tokyo in 1952 (now in the National Archives)
options.B: It was stolen by British soldiers in Taipei
options.C: It was lost at the bottom of the ocean
options.D: It was donated to a European university

questions.answer_text: The recovered melted gold ornaments and charred relics were returned to the Government of India in 1952.

questions.question: How did Netaji's philosophical synthesis of socialism, nationalism, and secularism shape modern Indian statecraft?

options.A: He championed state-led industrial planning (National Planning Committee 1938), complete gender equality, and fierce anti-communal secularism as the pillars of a progressive republic
options.B: He advocated return to medieval feudal monarchies
options.D: He opposed all scientific technology and modern industry

questions.answer_text: Netaji established the National Planning Committee with Nehru in 1938, pioneering modern economic planning for India.

questions.question: Why is Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose revered by military historians as one of the greatest military strategists of the 20th century?

options.A: For raising, equipping, and deploying an army of 50,000 soldiers on foreign soil without sovereign territory, creating modern Asia's first female combat regiment, and forcing the collapse of the world's largest empire

questions.answer_text: His organizational genius in creating an army and state in exile with multi-faith harmony remains unmatched in military history.

questions.question: What profound message does Netaji's life journey offer to future generations of citizens?

options.A: That unyielding moral courage, absolute selflessness, and fearless devotion to justice can overcome the most entrenched and powerful empires on earth
options.B: That one should avoid taking any personal risks in life
options.C: That material wealth is the only measure of success
options.D: That compromises are always preferable to principles

questions.answer_text: Netaji's life remains the ultimate beacon of fearless patriotism, secular brotherhood, and uncompromising integrity.

questions.question: Critically analyze the events of August 18, 1945, at Matsuyama Airport in Taipei and the ensuing medical emergency.
questions.reference_answer: Upon takeoff, the bomber's left engine failed catastrophically, plunging the plane into flames. Netaji's clothes caught fire as he escaped the fuselage. He was transported to Nanmon Hospital, where Dr. Tsuruta administered emergency resuscitation before Netaji succumbed to severe third-degree burns.

questions.question: Examine the conflicting findings of the various Indian inquiry commissions regarding Netaji's disappearance.
questions.reference_answer: The Shah Nawaz Committee (1956) and Khosla Commission (1970) confirmed that Netaji died in the Taipei air crash. In contrast, the Justice Mukherjee Commission (2005) concluded that the air crash was a planned cover story to facilitate Netaji's escape to the USSR, though its findings were not accepted by the Government.

questions.question: Assess Netaji's pioneering contribution to modern socio-economic planning and gender equality in India.
questions.reference_answer: As Congress President in 1938, Netaji founded the National Planning Committee, creating the blueprint for India's post-independence industrial economy. In the INA, he instituted the Rani of Jhansi Regiment, proving that women could lead and fight as frontline equals, revolutionizing Indian social empowerment.

questions.question: Synthesize the eternal legacy of Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose and his rightful place in world history.
questions.reference_answer: Netaji stands as a colossus of world history: a philosopher-warrior who dismantled British imperial hegemony through supreme courage, secular solidarity, and military genius. His sacrifice liberated 400 million people, and his motto 'Jai Hind' remains the beating heart of sovereign India.
key_concepts: Jai Hind beating heart of sovereign India

sequence_test.description: Trace the timeline from Netaji's departure from Saigon to the air crash in Taipei, the preservation of relics at Renkoji, and his enduring national legacy.

questions.question: What is the chronological sequence of events surrounding Netaji's reported air crash in August 1945?

options.A: Departure from Tourane / Saigon -> Takeoff from Matsuyama Airport Taipei (Aug 18, 1945) -> Engine failure and crash -> Treatment at Nanmon Hospital -> Relics transferred to Renkoji Temple Tokyo
options.B: Relics to Renkoji -> Engine failure -> Departure from Saigon -> Treatment at Nanmon Hospital
options.C: Treatment at Nanmon Hospital -> Relics to Renkoji -> Engine failure -> Departure from Saigon
options.D: Takeoff from Taipei -> Relics to Renkoji -> Departure from Saigon -> Treatment at Nanmon Hospital

questions.answer_text: Netaji boarded the plane in Saigon, took off in Taipei, crashed due to engine failure, received treatment at Nanmon, and relics were enshrined at Renkoji.

questions.question: Arrange the national and historic commemorative milestones of Netaji's legacy in chronological order:

options.A: Preservation of sacred relics at Renkoji Temple (1945) -> Declassification of confidential files -> Declaration of January 23 as Parakram Diwas -> Installation of grand granite statue at India Gate Canopy
options.B: Granite statue at India Gate -> Parakram Diwas -> Relics at Renkoji -> Declassification of files
options.C: Parakram Diwas -> Granite statue -> Relics at Renkoji -> Declassification of files
options.D: Declassification of files -> Granite statue -> Parakram Diwas -> Relics at Renkoji

questions.answer_text: Relics preserved at Renkoji, historical files declassified, January 23 declared Parakram Diwas, and the monumental statue unveiled at India Gate.
